name: IRONMAN 70.3 Pucon
notes: Swim in Lake Villarrica below the Villarrica volcano; rolling bike, hilly run.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 San Salvador
notes: Swim in Lake Ilopango, finish in San Salvador's historic centre; hilly bike and run. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Monterrey
notes: Swim in the Santa Lucía river walk at Parque Fundidora, flat urban course, finish at the Macroplaza. 2027 date TBA.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Curitiba
notes: Swim in the Passaúna Reservoir, finish at Barigui Park; bike rated hilly. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Punta del Este
notes: Swim at Playa Mansa (Ovo Beach), bike with repeated climbs at Punta Ballena, flat run along the rambla.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Dallas-Little Elm
notes: Lewisville Lake swim at Little Elm Park, north of Dallas. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Puerto Rico
notes: Condado Lagoon swim, flat bike, hilly run through Old San Juan, finish at Tercer Milenio Park.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Panama
notes: Ocean swim at Amador, flat course on the Amador Causeway by the Panama Canal entrance. Hot.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Oceanside
notes: Harbor swim, hilly bike through Camp Pendleton, finish at Oceanside Pier. Saturday race. IRONMAN Pro Series in 2027.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Texas
notes: Sheltered bay swim at Moody Gardens, flat and often windy course on Galveston Island.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 San Juan
notes: Swim in the Punta Negra dam reservoir, finish at Plaza del Bicentenario in the city; Andes foothills.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Puerto Varas
notes: Swim in Lake Llanquihue, rolling bike and run, finish at the Plaza de Armas. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Brasilia
notes: Swim in Lake Paranoá, flat bike and run from Pontão do Lago Sul.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Peru
notes: Pacific swim at Playa Agua Dulce in Chorrillos (Lima), flat bike and run.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Los Cabos
notes: Ocean swim at Palmilla Beach, rolling bike, finish at Plaza Mijares in San José del Cabo.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Gulf Coast
notes: Gulf of Mexico swim, flat bike and run. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Cap Cana
notes: Caribbean swim at Juanillo Beach, flat bike and run. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Chattanooga
notes: Downstream Tennessee River swim, rolling bike into Georgia, finish at Ross's Landing.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Victoria
notes: Elk Lake swim, rolling bike on the Saanich Peninsula, flat run around the lake.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Hawaii
notes: Ocean swim in Pauoa Bay at the Fairmont Orchid, bike on part of the Kona world championship course. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Barranquilla
notes: Sea swim at Puerto Mocho beach, finish at the Gran Malecón del Río. Hot. First held 2026; moves to April in 2027.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Omaha
notes: Swim in Lake Cunningham, rolling bike, run across the Bob Kerrey bridge into Iowa. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Western Massachusetts
notes: Connecticut River swim, bike rated hilly, finish in downtown Springfield. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Boulder
notes: Boulder Reservoir swim at ~1,600 m altitude; bike and run rated hilly. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Eagleman
notes: Choptank River swim, flat bike through the Blackwater wildlife refuge; often hot and windy.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Rockford-Illinois
notes: Downriver Rock River swim to transition at Davis Park, rolling bike, flat two-lap run.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Pennsylvania Happy Valley
notes: Swim at Bald Eagle State Park, finish at Beaver Stadium. 2026 was the North American Championship; Pro Series in 2027.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Coeur d'Alene
notes: Swim in Lake Coeur d'Alene from City Beach, hilly bike, finish on Sherman Avenue.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Mont-Tremblant
notes: Swim in Lac Tremblant, hilly bike, finish in the pedestrian village. IRONMAN Pro Series in 2027.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Muskoka
notes: Fairy Lake swim, tough rolling bike, hilly run; transition at the Canada Summit Centre in Huntsville.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Muncie
notes: Prairie Creek Reservoir swim, flat rural bike, rolling run. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Musselman
notes: Seneca Lake swim at Geneva, rolling bike and run in the Finger Lakes.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Ruidoso New Mexico
notes: High-altitude race (~2,100 m): Grindstone Lake swim, hilly bike, finish in Ruidoso. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Ecuador
notes: Pacific swim in Manta, rolling bike, finish at the cruise terminal. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Oregon
notes: Downstream Willamette River swim, flat bike and run, finish at Riverfront Park in Salem.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Ohio
notes: Ferry jump start into Lake Erie, flat bike, run through downtown Sandusky.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Boise
notes: Point-to-point: Lucky Peak Reservoir swim, hilly bike, finish downtown. Hot (average high ~38 °C). Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Maine
notes: Kennebec River swim in Augusta, rolling bike and run.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Calgary
notes: Ghost Lake swim, rolling foothills bike, finish at Cochrane Ranche west of Calgary. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Rio de Janeiro
notes: Ocean swim at Copacabana, flat bike and run, finish at Marina da Glória.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Northern California
notes: Whiskeytown Lake swim, net-downhill bike, run on the Sacramento River Trail. First held 2026.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Wisconsin
notes: Lake Monona swim at Law Park, rolling bike, hilly run in Madison. Saturday race. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Santa Cruz
notes: Pacific swim at Main Beach by the wharf, finish at Cowell's Beach. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Cozumel
notes: Caribbean swim at Chankanaab park, flat island bike, finish in downtown San Miguel. Hot and humid.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Michigan
notes: Swim in sheltered Betsie Bay off Lake Michigan, bike on M-22, run around the bay. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Washington Tri-Cities
notes: Columbia River swim at Howard Amon Park, finish at Columbia Point Park. 2027 date not yet announced.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 São Paulo
notes: Swim in the USP Olympic rowing basin (Raia Olímpica), flat bike and run from the university sports centre.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 New York
notes: Sheltered swim in Zach's Bay at Jones Beach State Park, flat bike and run. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Augusta
notes: Downstream Savannah River swim from North Augusta (SC), rolling bike, finish at Augusta Common.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Buenos Aires Palermo
notes: Swim in the Lago de Regatas in Palermo's parks, flat run in the city.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Waco
notes: Brazos River swim, flat bike, finish at Indian Spring Park. Often hot (average high ~34 °C).

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Encarnacion
notes: Paraná River swim, finish at Playa San José; bike rated hilly.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 North Carolina
notes: Point-to-point: current-assisted swim at Wrightsville Beach, flat bike, finish in downtown Wilmington. Saturday race.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Florianopolis
notes: Sea swim at Jurerê Internacional beach on Santa Catarina Island; flat bike and run.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Campeche
notes: Gulf of Mexico swim and flat course along the Campeche waterfront. Moved from March (last held Mar 2025) to November.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Aracaju-Sergipe
notes: Swim at the Vaza-Barris river mouth, flat bike and run, finish at Atalaia Beach.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Cartagena
notes: Bay swim from Muelle de la Bodeguita, flat course, finish in the walled old town. Hot and humid.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Valdivia
notes: Calle-Calle River swim, flat course. Same day as the full-distance IRONMAN Valdivia.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 La Quinta
notes: Lake Cahuilla swim, flat desert course, finish at SilverRock Park. Formerly IRONMAN 70.3 Indian Wells-La Quinta.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Veracruz
notes: Inaugural edition. Swim at Gaviotas Beach in Boca del Río, two-loop bike, run along the Veracruz malecón.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Florida
notes: Lake Eva swim, rolling bike and run in central Florida.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship
notes: Qualification only. Women and men race on separate days (Aug 28-29). Tennessee River swim, hilly bike.
